skills.name: Drain Vigor
skills.description:
Siphon away your enemies' vitality, dealing |cffffff3088|r Magic Damage, healing you for |cffffff26|r% of your missing Health, and restoring |cffffff9|r% of your missing Stamina every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff3|r seconds.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Stupefy
skills.description:
Subdue enemies in front of you with your baleful gaze, stunning them for |cffffff5|r seconds if they are facing your direction.

This stun cannot be blocked.

After the stun ends they remain stupefied, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds.

skills.name: Elusive Mist
skills.description:
Disperse into a dark mist, causing the next |cffffff3|r projectiles to deal no damage to you for |cffffff1|r second while you dash forward and reappear at your target location after a short duration.

You gain Major Expedition and Major Evasion for |cffffff3.3|r seconds after reappearing, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% and reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r%.

Casting again within |cffffff4|r seconds costs |cffffff33|r% more Magicka.

skills.name: Arterial Burst
skills.description:
Rend an enemy, dealing |cffffff8416|r Magic Damage and applying the Hemorrhaging status effect.

Deals up to |cffffff33|r% more damage based on your missing Health.

If you use this ability while you are under |cffffff50|r% Health, it will always be a Critical Strike.

skills.name: Sated Fury
skills.description:
Allow your monstrous appetites to take hold, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff60|r every |cffffff2|r seconds, up to |cffffff5|r times.

While toggled on, the Health cost of this ability increases by |cffffff300|r per stack and you cannot be healed by anyone but yourself, your pets, or your Companions.

When toggled off, you heal for |cffffff33|r% of the total Health cost you spent while active.

skills.name: Swarming Scion
skills.description:
Transform into a monstrous creature of the night, instantly healing to full Health.

While transformed, your Max Health, Magicka, and Stamina are increased by |cffffff10000|r, you heal for |cffffff15|r% of all damage you deal, and you can see enemies through walls. 

Bats also swarm around you and shred enemies that come close, dealing |cffffff3055|r Magic Damage every |cffffff1|r second.
